messages:
tess-devex: Quick note — onboarding folks flagged the starter README. Two copy/paste issues: curl uses `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY` but docker-compose uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and JS example expects `apiKey` named env. People get 401s.

noah-docs: Oof. Can you paste the problematic snippets? I'll patch right away.

lee-eng: Repro steps: clone, docker-compose up, run README curl -> 401. compose.yml uses `environment: - REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}` but README shows `export REDWOOD_KEY=...`

tess-devex: Current README curl (bad):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

sammy-se: I can open a quick PR to: (1) standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY, (2) change curl header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (3) add a one-line troubleshoot: "401 -> check env var and header style." Also add side-by-side curl/JS/Go examples to avoid shape drift.

noah-docs: Please include before/after in the PR description; that speeds review. Also add a tiny smoke job that hits a mock endpoint so we catch this in CI.

lee-eng: Another subtle mismatch: Go example shows `client.New(ctx, apiKey)` but our Go SDK uses `client.NewClient(ctx, client.WithAPIKey(apiKey))`. Might as well correct that too.

deploy-bot: PR opened by sammy-se: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-samples/pull/412 — CI: lint + sample-smoke-test started. :rocket:

noah-docs: Great — once merged I'll patch the quickstart landing and add a changelog note so support tickets can point to the fix.

tess-devex: Thanks all — this should reduce first-day friction. :smile:
